schema.name: batch_fp
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX batch_fp ON batch (tenant, fingerprint)

schema.name: batch_time
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX batch_time ON batch (tenant, seq, min_ts, max_ts) WHERE min_ts IS NOT NULL AND max_ts IS NOT NULL

schema.name: batch
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE batch ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, rows INTEGER NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, payload BLOB, min_ts INTEGER, max_ts INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, seq))

schema.name: config
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE config (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: notify
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE notify (tenant TEXT PRIMARY KEY, due INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: segment
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE segment ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, seq_lo INTEGER NOT NULL, seq_hi INTEGER NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, rows INTEGER NOT NULL, recorded_at INTEGER, sealed_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, seq_lo))

schema.name: series_window
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE series_window ( tenant TEXT NOT NULL, bucket INTEGER NOT NULL, data BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, bucket))

schema.name: stream
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE stream ( tenant TEXT PRIMARY KEY, incarnation INTEGER NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, sealed_through INTEGER NOT NULL, recorded_through INTEGER NOT NULL, discarded_through INTEGER NOT NULL, registered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

schema.name: viz_schema
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE viz_schema (one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1), component TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, compat INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
